name: cx-sequence
task: Find the key, pick it up, open the locked door, go into the room, and then pick up the ball.

value.feedback: CHANGES REQUIRED: All hard Existence clauses (key_found, has_matching_key, target_door_open, target_room_entered, target_picked_up) are redundant because the hard Precedence chain already forces each event to occur. Remove each of these Existence clauses; keep the Precedence clauses to express the ordering.

texts: the agent must find the key before picking it up
the agent must pick up the key before opening the door
the agent must open the door before entering the room
the agent must enter the room before picking up the ball
the agent must pick up the ball
